_doc: Contracts between carespace-ai repos. One edge = one surface a provider exposes and a consumer depends on. See repos/README.md > Relations.

edges.surface: Assistant HTTP + SSE protocol: /v1/threads routes, SSE event types (run.started, text.delta, detail.delta, tool.progress, card, action.proposal, action.result, app.open), display-card schema, /v1/speech/token and the /v1/voice/live WebSocket
Public Dart API of carespace_sdk (packages/flutter) and carespace_scan (packages/scan), consumed as git dependencies pinned to release tags and moved only by sdk-bump.yml
CareSpace REST API /v1 (raw bodies) and /v2 (envelope): routes, request and response shapes, auth headers
CareSpace REST API operations the agent may call, generated into catalog/operations.json from carespace-admin's openapi.json

CareSpace REST API used by the SDK service clients (auth/sign-in, rom/sessions, posture-analytics, plans, survey, evaluation, activity-stream, lets-move) and the scan queue's ROM-session upload contract
Design-system widgets and tokens of carespace_widgetbook, consumed as a path dependency; carespace-mobile's CI builds against widgetbook's default branch
Strapi collections the agent reads (GET only, fixed collection paths)
